message:
Add right-as-central build variants

build.yaml now emits both role variants for the standalone keyboard, so
either half can be the central without editing the matrix:

  left central  : ..._left_central     + ..._right_peripheral
  right central : ..._left_peripheral  + ..._right_central
  dongled       : ..._left_dongled     + ..._right_peripheral

Every target gets an explicit artifact-name so release assets and docs
stay in sync instead of relying on ZMK's <shield>-<board>-zmk fallback.

Upstream sets ZMK_KEYBOARD_NAME only under the _left shield, so a
right-as-central build advertised over Bluetooth with an empty name. Set
it in splitkb_aurora_lily58_right.conf — harmless while the right half is
a peripheral, correct once it is central. Verified with a local build:
CONFIG_ZMK_KEYBOARD_NAME="Aurora Lily58" alongside ROLE_CENTRAL=y.
